children: Corning entered an at‑the‑market equity program to sell up to $2.0 billion of common stock with Goldman Sachs as sales agent.
Entered an Equity Distribution Agreement with Goldman Sachs to sell up to $2.0 billion of common stock via an at‑the‑market program.
Company will set sale parameters and may sell shares from time to time based on market conditions and capital needs.
Proceeds expected to be used for general corporate purposes; Goldman Sachs paid a 1.0% commission on gross proceeds.
Sales will be made under Corning’s Form S‑3 shelf registration; a prospectus supplement was filed Sept. 11, 2026.
